verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a sevDesk feature for importing historical books or transaction history from another accounting system. The REST API (sevdesk-docs-23) is a developer building block that could be used to build an import, and the generic partner-integrations line (sevdesk-docs-14) does not describe migration, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can migrate historical books from another accounting system without losing transaction detail
